overall.verdict: This is the most conceptually honest wallet UI I have reviewed: one bar scale, an explicit promised-vs-enforceable split, frames and proofs on the surface, and a risk vocabulary that refuses to hide credit — it earns high marks on trust and visceral value. It loses points on execution: text clipped at the viewport edge on Desk and Sovereignty, unbounded decimal precision with a visible 10^7 arithmetic bug on Assets, colour-only risk coding, missing units and fees, and destructive actions (dispute, forget vault) that are simultaneously under-explained and under-confirmed. Fix the legibility and numeric hygiene and this is a 850+ product; the underlying model is already right.
priority_fixes: Never clip a number: give 16-desk's table a pinned column with horizontal scroll, and wrap 15-sovereignty's per-counterparty card inside the rail — the truncated text is the only path to reducing exposure.

Numeric hygiene across 01, 04, 06, 12, 15: append the currency unit to every capacity value, cap precision at 2 dp for USD and 6 dp for WETH, and fix the Assets '10% buffer (7449998 USDC)' magnitude error.

Make risk states decodable without colour: distinct luminance plus a glyph or word chip for on-chain / reserve / secured on 01-home, 15-sovereignty and 16-desk, and add a text-size control to 09-settings.

One fee line and one identity line per payment on 02-pay: reconcile 'under 0.01 USDC' against 'fee 0.0000025 of 0.0000050 total', add a named-recipient/address-book step, and show both parties' signatures on 03-receipt.

Weight irreversible actions correctly: held/typed confirmation with the frozen amount and chain cost on 06b-dispute, a sticky above-the-fold CTA with its blocking reason on 05b-swap-cross, and physical separation of Reveal recovery phrase from Forget vault on 09-settings.

06b-dispute: contrast collapse on the one screen that protects her money

personas.name: Omar
